name: sqlsugar
description: Edit embedded SQL strings inline and preview Jinja2/templated SQL with typed variables.

sqlsugar.tempFileCleanup.description: When enabled, SQLSugar deletes temporary Inline SQL files automatically according to cleanupOnClose.

sqlsugar.cleanupOnClose.description: Delete the temporary SQL file when its editor tab is closed. If false (and tempFileCleanup is true), delete on save instead after syncing back to the source.

sqlsugar.showSQLPreview.description: Show preview of original and injected SQL after copying

sqlsugar.sqlSyntaxHighlightTheme.description: [Advanced] SQL syntax highlighting theme for WebView

sqlsugar.sqlSyntaxHighlightFontSize.description: [Advanced] Font size for SQL syntax highlighting

sqlsugar.jinja2TypeInference.customRules.description: Custom type inference rules for Jinja2 variables

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to match variable names

sqlsugar.logLevel.description: Log level for WebView console output. 'error' shows only errors, 'none' disables all logs.

sqlsugar.enableWlCopyFallback.description: Enable wl-copy fallback for clipboard operations on Linux Wayland systems

sqlsugar.templatedSqlEditor.popoverPlace.description: [Advanced] Default placement for variable editing popovers in Templated SQL editor

sqlsugar.templatedSqlEditor.highlightSty.description: [Advanced] Visual style for highlighting variables in the template

sqlsugar.templatedSqlEditor.autoPreview.description: Automatically preview SQL when variables change in Templated SQL editor

sqlsugar.templatedSqlEditor.keyboardNavi.description: Enable keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Escape) in Templated SQL editor

sqlsugar.templatedSqlEditor.animationsEn.description: [Advanced] Enable animations and transitions in Templated SQL editor

sqlsugar.templatedSqlEditor.showSuggesti.description: Show intelligent value suggestions based on variable names

sqlsugar.templatedSqlEditor.autoFocusFir.description: Automatically focus the first variable when opening the Templated SQL editor

sqlsugar.templatedSqlEditor.scrollSyncEn.description: [Advanced] Enable bidirectional scroll synchronization between template and SQL preview

sqlsugar.paramStyle.enabledAnalyzers.description: Default enabled parameter analyzers. 'jinja2' is always recommended.

sqlsugar.paramStyle.defaultMode.description: Default analyzer selection mode. 'auto' detects analyzers from SQL content.

enumDescriptions: Use the OS temporary directory (outside the workspace; recommended)
sqlsugar.tempFileLocation.description: Where to store temporary Inline SQL files. Default osTemp keeps temp files out of your repo.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with SQLSugar
walkthroughs.description: Learn the two main workflows for embedded SQL.

steps.title: Edit Inline SQL
steps.description:
Select an embedded SQL string (or place the cursor inside it after selection improvements), then run **SQLSugar: Edit Inline SQL** or press the default shortcut to open a temporary `.sql` file beside your code.

[Open Command Palette](command:workbench.action.showCommands)

steps.title: Open Templated SQL Editor
steps.description:
Select a Jinja2 / parameterized SQL template and run **SQLSugar: Open Templated SQL Editor** to fill variables and preview rendered SQL.

[Open Command Palette](command:workbench.action.showCommands)

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build:declarations && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build:declarations && node esbuild.js --production
